title: Profile cards: solid card vs full-bleed photo with progressive blur
attribution_visible_in_image: A very small watermark at the bottom-right is illegible at this resolution.

observed.layout: Two profile cards on a near-black background. Left: dark grey card with the photo in a rounded rectangle at the top, 'Sophie Bennett' with a green verified badge, a grey two-line bio, two stat counts (312 and 48 with icons) and a dark 'Follow +' pill. Right: the photo fills the whole card and fades progressively into blur and dark at the bottom; text is white, badge is white/grey, and the Follow pill is white with dark text.
observed.typography: Clean sans; white names, grey (left) or white (right) bio. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Tiny outline stat icons; verified seal.
observed.materials: Left: solid card. Right: progressive blur and gradient mask over the photo.

interpretation.aesthetic: Premium dark profile cards where the photo blends into the content.
implementation_notes: Progressive blur: stacked backdrop-filter layers with increasing blur plus a gradient mask, or a gradient scrim.
Follow pill inverts to white to stay visible over the photo.

concept_work.essence: Dissolve the boundary between photo and text so the card reads as one surface.
what_makes_it_work: Text sits on a controlled blurred/dark area.
Controlled comparison: only the treatment changes between variants.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The first line of the right bio measures about 2.7-3.1:1 over the blurred mid-grey area.
Backdrop blur costs performance on low-end devices.

pattern.name: Progressive blur photo-to-text transition
use_when: Cards where photography is the identity
avoid_when: Photos with bright bottoms and no scrim
must_preserve: A button treatment that flips for contrast
adaptation_examples: Real-estate listing: photo fades into price and address.
Event card: poster fades into date and CTA.
failure_modes: Bio line over blurred mid-grey near 3:1

lessons: Pair any text-over-photo treatment with a measured scrim.
Present variants that change one variable at a time.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Neutral dark page; green appears only in the left badge; the Follow pill flips from dark to white across variants.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Social profile with a clear follow action.
Photo-led composition with a smooth transition to text.
Profile card conventions are met; progressive blur is applied with a contrast-aware button flip.
Follow is clear; no followed/hover/loading state shown.
The two variants differ only in treatment, giving a clean comparison.
Progressive blur integration goes beyond the standard photo-top card.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 11.69:1; secondary text min 2.73:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
